title: Research: prove dirty defect composition and sharpen the tree envelope
head: eae990ad622de32c0907d55450bf00c784fd40c3
body:
The uniform dirty-register defect recurrence from #2596 now has a kernel-checked composition theorem and a sharper tree envelope. For every ordered binary tree, the scalar recurrence is bounded by H_n E0, where H_0=0 and H_(n+1)=L^n+2H_n. Lean proves (L-2)H_n=L^n-2^n and that an earlier-leaf comb attains this scalar recurrence maximum. For L>=4, H_n<=2L^(n-1), removing the factor n from the data-rounding term. The separate coefficient-perturbation term retains n.

The formal interface names additive shadows, gauge/Lipschitz bounds, uniform defects, closed source domains and domain-preserving leaves. A proved integer-to-rational lift connects it to Gareth Davidson's existing NonlinearEcho four-call dispatcher, retaining chafreaky's PR628/PR663 credit. A nontrivial noisy scalar leaf is instantiated for every tree/input/dirt. The actual PR628 rounded leaf and complex Euclidean norm are not instantiated here; no physical error sharpness, supplier, selected exponent or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

Validation: live Lean 4.34.1 compiles nineteen audited roots with only standard axioms and rejects five changed claims plus a real injected-axiom query. Registered Python 3.12 passes 591 exact nonlinear cases on all 197 shapes through seven leaves, 985 scalar-envelope cases, source pins and premise/order controls. Git-free empty-PATH export, unchanged-file checks and four source/receipt corruption rejections pass. All nine publication files match the tested working bytes. The registered Python hook deliberately does not claim to run Lean; the live command is documented. Hosted CI has not been checked.

Started from fresh canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4; final fetch remains unchanged. The prescribed baseline passed. Exact #2596 head 8472f5470f7ef5f24a910ccdc73cdd0d000c002c is pinned. Complete cached overlap covers 786 open PRs at 15:35:57 UTC and 1239 Discussion records at 15:22:22 UTC; targeted REST checks supplemented this after GraphQL quota exhaustion. These coverage limits, the claim, task draw and open formal obligations are retained in the package. Independent review covered the proof and stronger-envelope follow-up; no actionable finding remained. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
